title: Fast Inference from Transformers via Speculative Decoding
author: Leviathan, Kalman and Matias (ICML 2023)
why: The original algorithm with the acceptance rule, the proof of exactness, and the expected-tokens and walltime formulas used in this section.

title: Accelerating Large Language Model Decoding with Speculative Sampling
author: Chen et al., DeepMind (2023)
why: Independent derivation of the same modified rejection sampling, applied to a 70B model with a clear statement of when it pays off.

title: Medusa: Simple LLM Inference Acceleration Framework with Multiple Decoding Heads
author: Cai et al. (ICML 2024)
why: Extra decoding heads, tree attention and typical acceptance: the main design for drafting without a second model.

title: EAGLE: Speculative Sampling Requires Rethinking Feature Uncertainty
author: Li et al. (ICML 2024)
why: Feature-level drafting that keeps the exact acceptance rule; a strong baseline for production draft heads.
